newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Gul Technologies offers 40.2 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Gul Technologies offers 40.2 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Printed circuit board maker Gul Technologies Singapore Ltd said on Monday it was offering 40.2 million new ordinary shares at Singapore S$0.58 each in its Singapore initial public offering (IPO).
Gul said in a statement the 40.2 million shares, to be listed on Singapore's second board SESDAQ, comprised 30.15 million offer shares and 10.05 million placement shares.
It said the shares at the offer price of S$0.58, have a historical price earnings ratio of 12.6 times.
The public offer represented 15 percent of its enlarged share capital of 267.6 million shares.
Estimated proceeds from the IPO of S$22 million would be used for a variety of purposes.

About S$10 million would be used to purchase machinery and equipment and to expand production. Another S$7.0 million would be used for additional working capital and the balance of S$5.0 million would be for partial repayment of term loans, which were used for capacity expansion.
Gul Technologies is a subsidiary of Singapore main-board listed Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd.
The offer is managed and lead underwritten by Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) and will close on March 13.
The shares will trade on a when-issued basis on March 17.
